Your personal playroom.

One HTML file. Your GitHub arcade.
Keep Playroom.html wherever you like and open it in a modern browser. The interface is built in. Games download from your GitHub repository when you play them.

Does it work without internet?

You can browse the library offline, but opening games requires internet to download their files from GitHub. Many games also fetch assets and emulators from their original online hosts, so their availability depends on those hosts.

How do the games load?

Only the game you select is downloaded. Very large games may take longer; the player shows download progress. All game pages live in your GitHub repository, so there is no file picker or separate local games folder.

A game is blank or won’t start

Give large games time to download. Click any Play or Start button inside the game, then click the game area to give it keyboard control. Try Restart or a current version of Chrome or Edge. Some source pages have unavailable external assets or browser compatibility issues. The catalog includes every supplied game page, but inclusion does not mean each external game has been verified.

Favorites, history, and game saves

Favorites and recent history stay in this browser where local storage is available. Moving this file or using a private browser window can reset them. In-game saves depend on the individual game or emulator; use its save/export control when available. Closing or restarting a game stops it.

What’s included?

All game titles belong to their respective creators. The original archive files were left untouched. Cover illustrations in this library are decorative, not game screenshots.
